kind: A screen with one seed on the laptop's GPU: the capped practice from rewarded attempts of practice_within_reach.json again from its two models, with one addition. Every round also rehearses what the written corpus taught: the written chains of fresh tasks of 1 to 4 hops.
why: Capped practice lengthens the stack's written chains fourfold and then loses them. In practice_within_reach.json the stack's arm with both changes (cap-bursts-stack: the staircase capped at 8 hops, only rewarded attempts teach) answered 0.955 to 0.960 of the tasks of 8 hops right at every evaluation from round 100 to round 700, with the whole chain right in 0.925 to 0.945 of its answers, 0.835 to 0.910 at 12 hops (whole chain 0.765 to 0.845), and kept 2 and 4 hops at 0.98 or better: before practice it answered 0.105 at 8 hops with no whole chain. The model kept at round 700 writes the whole chain right in 0.905 of its answers at 10 hops, 0.815 at 12, 0.720 at 16 and 0.335 at 20, lengths it never practised (the chains it read end at 4 hops, the ones it practised at 8). Then it lost all of it within some 50 rounds: the solve rate of its rounds went from 0.959 (rounds 701 to 720) to 0.862 and 0.536 over the next two blocks of 20 rounds, the staircase left 8 hops after round 757 and first stood at 1 hop at round 773, and at round 800 the model answers 0.14 of the tasks of 2 hops and 0.10 at 8, with answers of 57 to 59 bytes: it writes names until the room ends and has lost the stop of a chain. It did not return: after 2,000 rounds 0.10 at 6 hops, 0.09 at 8, 0.108 over 1 to 4 hops, no whole chain. The capped arm that keeps GRPO's dips (cap-stack) stood as high at round 200 (0.94, 0.93 and 0.82 at 6, 8 and 12 hops) and was falling by round 300 (0.615 at 2 hops, 0.705 at 8). So the practice works and does not hold. Two measurements on the kept models say why it may not. Between rounds 600 and 700, with 0.95 of the attempts solved, the weights moved 0.58 times as far as over the first 100 rounds (a mean change of 2.0e-4 an entry against 3.4e-4, at a rate of 3e-5): the few tasks that still disagree give gradients above the clip (norms of 1.0 to 3.6 in three of four rounds from the model of round 600, 13.5 to 15.9 from the model before practice), and Adam's steps keep their size whatever is left to learn. And nothing pulls back: with bursts alone an attempt that fails teaches nothing, so once attempts fail in a new way, by not ending, the loop has no lesson against it, and what the corpus taught (after the digit, a newline) is never repeated. This is a reading of weights and gradients, not a test. The brain keeps old memories under new learning by replaying them between the new (McClelland, McNaughton and O'Reilly 1995), and practice_within_reach.json names rehearsal of the written corpus as the next registration if no arm of the stack meets its marks. This is that registration, recorded while bursts-stack and the Transformer's arms of that screen have yet to finish: both capped arms of the stack have shown their peak and their loss, and the question no longer waits on the arm without a cap.
loop: experiments/practice_loop.py as cap-bursts ran it in practice_within_reach.json: every round 16 tasks at the current number of hops, verified, 8 attempts each at temperature 1.0 with room for 64 bytes; reward 1 if the last byte before the newline is the answer; the staircase from 4 hops, capped at 8 (--longest-hops 8); only attempts above their task's mean teach (--dips 0); Adam at 3e-5, gradients clipped at 1; 2,000 rounds; seed 0. New: --rehearse 16. Every round draws 16 fresh tasks of 1, 2, 3 or 4 hops (evenly, from a generator of its own, so the practised tasks are drawn as before), writes each one's chain as the corpus writes it, and adds the mean cost a byte of those chains to the round's loss with weight 1, the same measure of likelihood that the policy step uses. A round whose attempts all agree takes the rehearsal's step alone.

arms.rehearse-bursts-stack: --longest-hops 8 --dips 0 --rehearse 16, from chain-stack (the averaged weights of written_chains.json)
arms.beside them: cap-bursts-stack and cap-bursts-tf of practice_within_reach.json: the same loop without rehearsal, the same seed

code: The frozen copy be42570 with the experiments/practice_loop.py of commit 38c215f and the experiments/hop_tasks.py of 1a127c7 (code-be42570-rehearse). Without --rehearse this loop repeats the copy that ran practice_within_reach.json round for round: checked on 5 rounds from chain-stack on the CPU with another seed (99), the two logs equal byte for byte. On the laptop's GPU, one run at a time: rehearse-bursts-stack after cap-stack of practice_within_reach.json, rehearse-bursts-tf after that screen's last arm.
measure: As practice_within_reach.json. Along the way: before the first round and after every 100 rounds, 200 tasks each of 2, 4, 6, 8 and 12 hops answered greedily (--evaluate-every 100 --evaluate-hops 2 4 6 8 12 --evaluate-tasks 200), each scored model kept; the evaluation before the first round must repeat the registered evaluation before practice, or the code copy is examined before anything is read. After the last round: --evaluate 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 10 12 16 20 --evaluate-tasks 200 --max-bytes 64 --seed 0 (the eleven hop counts of practice_within_reach.json and 20 hops, whose chain of 59 bytes still fits): the accuracy of the last byte with its 95% Wilson interval, the share of answers that write the whole chain right, the mean bytes. The rounds' log with the rehearsal's loss.
reading: By the marks of practice_written_chains.json on the evaluation after 2,000 rounds: (a) at 6 hops an accuracy of at least 0.50 with at least half of the answers writing the whole chain right; (b) the same at 8 hops; (c) a mean accuracy over 1 to 4 hops of at least 0.95. And one mark on the way there: (h) the arm holds if at every one of the 20 evaluations from round 100 to round 2,000 it meets (b) and answers at least 0.95 of the tasks of 2 hops and of 4 hops (cap-bursts-stack met this at rounds 100 to 700 and at none after). (1) Rehearsal keeps what practice wins if the stack's arm meets (a), (b), (c) and (h). If it meets (a), (b) and (c) and not (h), it lost its chains on the way and found them again: reported as that, and no pass. If it fails (a) or (c), rehearsal as built does not hold the chains, and the next registration shrinks the loop's steps once a length is solved. (2) Rehearsal does not cost the gain if the arm meets (b) at round 100 or at round 200 (cap-bursts-stack at round 100: 0.925 at 6 hops with 0.915 whole chains, 0.960 at 8 with 0.930). (3) The stack against the Transformer under the same loop: one practises further if at 6 hops and at 8 its accuracy after 2,000 rounds is at least 0.10 above the other's with the two 95% intervals apart. Reported and not read: the accuracies and whole-chain shares at 10, 12, 16 and 20 hops, the rounds' solve rates and whole-chain shares, the rehearsal's loss. One seed, synthetic tasks: a screen of whether the loop holds what it wins, not a claim about reasoning in language. What follows: if the stack's arm passes (1), the same run with seeds 1 and 2 from both models before anything is built on it; then this loop is the practice of the one-model plan, and the cap is raised under it.
seen_before_recording: practice_within_reach.json's runs as far as they had come: cap-bursts-stack in full (its 2,000 rounds, its 21 evaluations along the way, its evaluation after); evaluations on the CPU of its models kept at rounds 100, 700 and 800, at the eleven hop counts and 20 hops; how far the weights moved between its kept models, and the gradient norms of four rounds each from the models kept at rounds 0, 100 and 600 (the rehearsal's loss at those models is 0.002 to 0.003, its gradient norm 0.2 to 0.5); cap-stack through round 430 with its evaluations to round 400; cap-bursts-tf through round 267, where it was paused, with its evaluations at rounds 100 and 200 (0.295 and 0.740 at 6 hops, 0.240 and 0.475 at 8); bursts-stack, cap-tf and bursts-tf had not started. practice_written_chains.json with its result. Of rehearsal: 5 rounds from chain-stack on the CPU with seed 99, whose solve rates and losses were seen (the rehearsal's loss 0.002 to 0.018) and whose model was not evaluated.
